avdeling.label: Department
avdeling.tooltip: A department is a group of staff with similar tasks, profession, and regulations.
avdeling.add_bar_toggle: Add Bar as a separate department
avdeling.add_events_toggle: Add Events as a separate department

stilling.label: Position
stilling.tooltip: Position is the role type within a department (Bartender, Head Chef). Not a person.

tilgangsniva.label: Access Level
tilgangsniva.tooltip: Access level is the security level (not a job title). Used for what parts of the system staff can use.

omrade.label: Area
omrade.tooltip: Area is a physical operational room inside the workspace (Bar, Kitchen, Floor).

sone.label: Zone
sone.tooltip: Zone is a part of an area where a shift can be assigned (Bar 1, Dish Station).

lag.label: Team
lag.tooltip: Team is a concrete group of staff working together on a shift.

vakt.label: Shift
vakt.tooltip: Shift is a planned work assignment for an employee on a date.
